nodes.label: msk_handcuffs
nodes.summary: FiveM handcuffs/restraints resource by MSK Scripts. Provides cuffing, dragging, ankletracker, headbag and tape mechanics plus an in-game admin dashboard.

nodes.label: v2 (legacy)
nodes.summary: Previous major version. Used config.lua and database.json, Config.Target only registered the undrag key and there were no target options.

nodes.label: Migration page (documentation)
nodes.summary: External documentation page describing renamed exports and events, to be read before updating if another resource hooks into Handcuffs.

nodes.label: msk_core
nodes.summary: MSK shared library that provides the framework bridge. It auto-detects whether ESX or QBCore is running, so no framework setting is needed.

nodes.label: oxmysql
nodes.summary: MySQL wrapper resource. Required as of v3.0.0; all state is stored through it and the tables are created on first start.

nodes.label: ESX Legacy
nodes.summary: Supported FiveM framework, detected automatically through msk_core.

nodes.label: QBCore
nodes.summary: Framework support added in v3.0.0 next to ESX Legacy, detected automatically by msk_core.

nodes.label: ox_target
nodes.summary: Recommended target resource for the new target menu. Picked automatically when Config.Target.system is set to auto and ox_target is running.

nodes.label: qb-target
nodes.summary: Alternative target resource. Used as fallback when ox_target is not running.

nodes.label: ox_inventory
nodes.summary: Supported inventory system. Items added or changed in the dashboard register without a server restart.

nodes.label: jaksam_inventory
nodes.summary: Supported inventory system for restart-free item registration.

nodes.label: luxu_admin
nodes.summary: Optional admin resource. luxu_admin v2 keeps its staff groups internal instead of registering ACE principals, so msk_handcuffs queries it directly.

nodes.label: React NUI (web/ built into html/)
nodes.summary: React-based NUI source in web/, built into html/. Hosts the admin dashboard plus the headbag blackscreen and cuff sounds on one shared page.

nodes.label: QBCore support
nodes.summary: The script runs on QBCore in addition to ESX Legacy. Framework detection happens in msk_core, nothing is configured by the user.

nodes.label: Target menu integration
nodes.summary: Real third-eye target integration for ox_target and qb-target with per-action entries. Labels are translated into the dashboard language and follow the current state.

nodes.label: In-game admin dashboard
nodes.summary: NUI dashboard opened with /handcuffadmin. Tabs for Players, Items, Jobs, Settings and Permissions.

nodes.label: Permission system
nodes.summary: Per-action rights so staff can be given partial dashboard access, for example cuff and uncuff without settings access. Managed in the Permissions tab.

nodes.label: Theme editor
nodes.summary: Live recoloring of the dashboard from the Settings tab.

nodes.label: Discord webhook setting
nodes.summary: The Discord logging webhook is a normal setting now and can be pasted in from the Settings tab instead of editing server/discord.lua.

nodes.label: No item needed to remove (optional)
nodes.summary: Toggles for headbag and tape. By default no item is required to take them off; enabling the toggle requires a remove item again.

nodes.label: Keep the remove items (optional)
nodes.summary: Toggles so the item used to remove a restraint is not consumed. Covers the ankletracker key, headbag key, tape key and the uncuff item. Off by default so keys stay reusable.

nodes.label: Escort hint (TextUI)
nodes.summary: While dragging a cuffed person a small TextUI shows the actually bound undrag key. Follows FiveM keybind changes and is translated into every language.

nodes.label: luxu_admin support
nodes.summary: Queries luxu_admin directly for staff groups, with options to rename the resource, require on-duty status and map luxu_admin groups onto dashboard groups.

nodes.label: MySQL storage instead of database.json
nodes.summary: Cuff status, ankletracker and all other state live in a msk_handcuffs table through oxmysql. No .sql import, the table is created on first start.

nodes.label: Automatic database.json import
nodes.summary: An old database.json is imported into MySQL once, automatically, and the original file is kept as a backup.

nodes.label: Status readable through statebags
nodes.summary: Every status sits in a replicated statebag so other resources can read whether a player is cuffed without a callback.

nodes.label: Database as source of truth
nodes.summary: Config is imported once on first start; afterwards the database is authoritative and values are edited from the dashboard.

nodes.label: Config split into settings and static
nodes.summary: config/settings.lua holds dashboard-editable values, config/static.lua holds code parts like notification, voice and mute handling, control blacklist and prop list.
nodes.norm_label: config split into settings and static

nodes.label: Rebuilt shared interface
nodes.summary: Headbag blackscreen and cuff sounds run through a rebuilt interface that shares one NUI page with the dashboard. No behavior change for players.

nodes.label: Default items always work
nodes.summary: With Config.RestrictItems enabled, default items and options remain usable regardless of job; the job only adds its own on top.

nodes.label: Matching key for the right cuffs
nodes.summary: Uncuffing only works with the item matching how the person was cuffed: cable ties open with scissors, handcuffs with the cuff keys.
nodes.norm_label: matching key for the right cuffs

nodes.label: Item label in missing-item notification
nodes.summary: Missing-item notifications name the in-game item label instead of the internal item name.

nodes.label: Items register without a restart
nodes.summary: Items added or changed in the dashboard become usable immediately on ESX, QBCore, ox_inventory and jaksam_inventory without a server restart.

nodes.label: Fully server-sided authority
nodes.summary: The client only requests; the server validates distance, item ownership, job and current status. Players can no longer set their own cuff status.

nodes.label: Server-side auto-uncuff timer
nodes.summary: The auto-uncuff timer now runs on the server, closing the old exploit where a cuffed player could free themselves.

nodes.label: Server-side uncuff on death
nodes.summary: Uncuffing on death is handled on the server instead of the client.

nodes.label: Self-free exploit removed
nodes.summary: The old trick where a cuffed player could free themselves is gone because the relevant timers moved to the server.

nodes.label: Live language switching
nodes.summary: Target entries are translated into the dashboard language; changing the language in the dashboard updates the text live.

nodes.label: Players tab
nodes.summary: Lists every online player with their current status and allows cuff, hardcuff, uncuff and one-click toggling of ankletracker, headbag and tape.

nodes.label: Items tab
nodes.summary: Dashboard tab to manage the resource's items.

nodes.label: Jobs tab (job restrictions)
nodes.summary: Dashboard tab to manage the job restrictions for items and actions.

nodes.label: Settings tab
nodes.summary: Dashboard tab for all settings, including the theme editor, language and the Discord webhook.

nodes.label: Permissions tab
nodes.summary: Dashboard tab that manages which groups get which rights and who is allowed in.

nodes.label: Cuff
nodes.summary: Cuffing a nearby player. Available as a target option and from the dashboard Players tab.

nodes.label: Hardcuff
nodes.summary: Hardcuff variant of the cuff action, available via target and dashboard.

nodes.label: Uncuff
nodes.summary: Removes cuffs. Requires the item matching how the person was cuffed.

nodes.label: Ankletracker
nodes.summary: Ankle tracker that can be put on or taken off, toggled via target or the dashboard. Its state is persisted in the database.

nodes.label: Headbag
nodes.summary: Headbag that blacks out the victim's screen. Toggleable via target and dashboard; the state-aware label reads put on or remove.

nodes.label: Tape
nodes.summary: Tape over the mouth to mute a player. Toggleable via target and dashboard.

nodes.label: Drag / escort
nodes.summary: Dragging a cuffed player around. While dragging, the escort hint shows the bound undrag key.

nodes.label: Put in car
nodes.summary: Target option to put a cuffed player into a vehicle.

nodes.label: Put out of car
nodes.summary: Target option to pull a cuffed player out of a vehicle.

nodes.label: Undrag key
nodes.summary: Keybind that releases a dragged player. In v2 it was the only thing Config.Target registered; the escort hint now displays whatever key is actually bound.

nodes.label: Config.Target
nodes.summary: Target integration config table. In v2 it only registered the undrag key; in v3.0.0 it configures the full target menu.

nodes.label: Config.Target.options
nodes.summary: Per-option switches for the target entries: cuff, hardcuff, uncuff, ankletracker, headbag, tape, drag, put in car and put out of car.

nodes.label: Config.Target.system
nodes.summary: Selects the target system. Default 'auto' picks ox_target when it is running and falls back to qb-target.

nodes.label: Config.adminCommand
nodes.summary: Name of the chat command that opens the admin dashboard. Defaults to handcuffadmin.

nodes.label: Config.dashboardGroups
nodes.summary: Decides which groups may open the admin dashboard at all.

nodes.label: Config.MaxDistance
nodes.summary: New in v3.0.0. Maximum distance between the two players; every action is measured against it on the server.

nodes.label: Config.RestrictItems
nodes.summary: Restricts items and options by job. With it enabled the default items still always work and the job adds its own on top.

nodes.label: Config.LuxuAdmin
nodes.summary: luxu_admin integration config in config/static.lua: enable or auto, resource name, on-duty requirement and group mapping onto dashboard groups.

nodes.label: /handcuffadmin
nodes.summary: In-game command that opens the admin dashboard. Renameable through Config.adminCommand.

nodes.label: group.admin
nodes.summary: ACE group that can always do everything in the dashboard, regardless of the configured rights.

nodes.label: group.user
nodes.summary: ACE group that can never enter the dashboard.

nodes.label: Job restrictions
nodes.summary: Job-based gating of which items and actions a player may use, editable in the Jobs tab and validated on the server.

nodes.label: cuff_keys
nodes.summary: Uncuff item for handcuffs. Only opens handcuffs, not cable ties.

nodes.label: scissors
nodes.summary: Uncuff item for cable ties. Only opens cable ties, not handcuffs.

nodes.label: Ankletracker key
nodes.summary: Remove item for the ankle tracker. Can optionally be kept in the inventory when used.

nodes.label: Headbag key
nodes.summary: Remove item for the headbag. Not required by default in v3.0.0 and optionally not consumed.

nodes.label: Tape key
nodes.summary: Remove item for the tape. Not required by default in v3.0.0 and optionally not consumed.

nodes.label: Handcuffs
nodes.summary: Metal cuffs restraint type. Can only be opened with the cuff keys.

nodes.label: Cable ties
nodes.summary: Cable tie restraint type. Can only be opened with scissors.

nodes.label: msk_handcuffs (table)
nodes.summary: MySQL table holding the cuff status, the ankletracker and the rest of the player state. Created on first start, unchanged by the settings/permissions tables.

nodes.label: msk_handcuffs_settings (table)
nodes.summary: MySQL table created automatically to hold the dashboard-managed settings.

nodes.label: msk_handcuffs_permissions (table)
nodes.summary: MySQL table created automatically to hold the group permissions of the dashboard.

nodes.label: config/settings.lua
nodes.summary: New config file holding all values that can also be changed in the dashboard. Seeded into the database on first start.

nodes.label: config/static.lua
nodes.summary: New config file holding the code parts: notification, voice and mute handling, control blacklist, prop list and Config.LuxuAdmin.

nodes.label: config.lua (removed)
nodes.summary: The old single config file. Removed in v3.0.0 and replaced by the config/ folder.

nodes.label: database.json (removed)
nodes.summary: The old JSON state store. Removed in v3.0.0; an existing file is imported once into MySQL and kept as a backup.

nodes.label: server/discord.lua
nodes.summary: Discord logging module. Used to hold the webhook URL; the webhook moved into the config and the dashboard in v3.0.0.

nodes.label: Cuff (removed export)
nodes.summary: Self-cuff export removed in v3.0.0 as part of the move to full server authority.

nodes.label: Hardcuff (removed export)
nodes.summary: Self-hardcuff export removed in v3.0.0.

nodes.label: Uncuff (removed export)
nodes.summary: Self-uncuff export removed in v3.0.0.

nodes.label: Admin exports (removed)
nodes.summary: The previous admin exports were removed in v3.0.0; admin actions go through the dashboard and its permission checks instead.

nodes.label: Renamed exports and events
nodes.summary: Several exports and events were renamed in v3.0.0. Resources hooking into Handcuffs must consult the migration page.

nodes.label: Replicated cuff-status statebag
nodes.summary: Replicated statebag carrying each player's restraint status so other resources can read it without a callback.

nodes.label: File config becomes inert after first start
nodes.summary: Breaking change: once the dashboard and database are in charge, editing a value in the config file has no effect unless it is also changed in the dashboard.
nodes.norm_label: file config becomes inert after first start

nodes.label: Full resource replacement on update
nodes.summary: v3.0.0 is a full rewrite, so the entire resource has to be replaced rather than patched file by file.

nodes.label: Version checker
nodes.summary: Server-side version check module (server/versionchecker.lua) added with the v3.0.0 rewrite.

nodes.label: shared/admin_perms.lua
nodes.summary: Shared module holding the admin permission constants that back the per-action rights system.

nodes.label: server/admin/ (store, permissions, seed, api, command, boot)
nodes.summary: Server-side admin backend added in v3.0.0: settings store, permission checks, database seeding, NUI api, the command registration and boot sequence.
nodes.norm_label: server/admin/ (store, permissions, seed, api, command, boot)

nodes.label: client/admin/ (main, nui, sync)
nodes.summary: Client-side admin dashboard glue added in v3.0.0: opening the dashboard, NUI callbacks and live sync.

nodes.label: server/database.lua
nodes.summary: New database layer that creates the tables on first start and handles the one-time database.json import.
